## Why

K0 §4.8 fixes the response-security posture and this row owns its first
implementation (SIG-UI-096): a strict CSP with per-page hashes and no
`'unsafe-inline'`/`'unsafe-eval'`, a `default-src 'none'` row for T0
record/print pages, HSTS, a deny Permissions-Policy with the sole
`geolocation=(self)` exception on `/map/`, and a dedicated sandboxed
policy for standalone figure SVGs. The honest constraint: a static build
emits files, not headers — and no static nginx config can name per-page
hashes. The row's owned decision (ADR-223) is the **meta ∩ header
split** whose browser-enforced intersection *is* K0's served posture.

## What ships

### The document layer (engineered)

- **`security.csp` in `web/astro.config.mjs`** — SHA-384 hashes; the
  emitted per-page `<meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy">` carries
  `default-src 'self'`, `script-src 'self' <hashes>`,
  `style-src 'self' <hashes>`, `img-src 'self' data: blob:`,
  `connect-src 'self'`, `worker-src 'self' blob:`, `font-src 'self'`,
  `object-src 'none'`, `base-uri 'none'`, `form-action 'self'`, and the
  `*-attr 'none'` pair. No `unsafe-*` anywhere.
- **`web/src/lib/csp.ts` + the `sig-page-types` build hook** — the T0
  tightening: each T0 route's emitted meta is rewritten to
  `default-src 'none'` with `script-src`/`connect-src`/`worker-src`
  dropped and `blob:` off `img-src` — K0's record/print row, asserted
  per-route by the e2e.
- **Every `style=""` gone** — the ContradictionRange track is an inline
  `<svg>` whose point positions are `cx` geometry attributes; the figure
  frames ride a new `.sig-figure-frame` class (token-backed, K13 C-08);
  the map island's mount-height reservation is the generated
  `--k0…--k24` class table (a 27th compartment row fails the build,
  never silently under-reserves); `NetworkIsland`'s JSX `style={{}}`
  became `sig-graph-island__pick`.
- **`MapIsland.tsx` text-only rendering** — the popups build DOM nodes
  (`createElement`/`textContent`) handed to `.setDOMContent`; the
  escaping-string `popupHtml`/`setHTML` path is gone.
- **`web/scripts/check-unsafe-dom.mjs`** (`check:dom` in
  `npm run check`) — bans `.innerHTML`, `.outerHTML`,
  `insertAdjacentHTML(`, `document.write(`, `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`
  and `.setHTML(` under `web/src/**` (comments stripped; vacuous-fails;
  proven on planted fixtures).

### The served layer (engineered; composed legs Docker-gated)

- **`ops/web/sig-security.conf`** — new committed static fragment:
  `Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains"`
  (no `preload` — a launch-row decision), the two interpolated policy
  headers, and the single `nosniff` source.
- **`$sig_csp` + `$sig_permissions_policy` maps** in BOTH
  `ops/web/nginx.conf` and `ops/web/nginx-legacy.conf` — keyed on the
  request so the dedicated figure policy follows `.svg` bytes under
  `/r/`, `/s/`, the latest view and the flat tree (a `location ~` block
  would have mis-rooted `/r/` svgs — rejected, ADR-223); `/map/` is the
  sole `geolocation=(self)` route. The fragment is included at server
  scope and inside every `add_header` location — the same inheritance
  rule `sig-headers.conf` exists for.
- **Header carries only hash-independent guards** —
  `frame-ancestors 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none';
  form-action 'self'; script-src-attr 'none'; style-src-attr 'none'` —
  a `default-src`/`script-src 'self'` there would deny the hashed
  bootstrap the meta lawfully admits (verified on real bytes).

### Tests

- `web/tests/e2e/csp.spec.ts` — **62 tests**: the per-route meta sweep,
  a zero-violation browser sweep over `/`, `/dispute/`, a print page,
  `/404.html` and all three hydrated T2 islands, four injection legs
  (each blocked *and* reported — `eval()` proven under a planted
  hash-admitted policy since CDP eval is exempt), and a CSP-free
  control proving the harness detects.
- `web/tests/e2e/csp-policy-check.ts` + `web/tests/unit/csp-policy.test.ts`
  — the check is proven on planted violating policies (missing/duplicate
  meta, `unsafe-*`, `*`, third-party origin, header-only directive in
  meta, missing attr-'none', untightened T0).
- `web/tests/unit/unsafe-dom-check.test.ts` — the grep is proven on
  planted sinks; comment-named sinks pass; vacuous is a failure.
- `tests/ops/test_web_iac.py` — the fragment verbatim, both templates'
  maps, the `/map/` sole exception, include-per-location coverage,
  single `nosniff` source, COPY-not-rendered.
- `tests/e2e/test_release_generations.py` — composed assertions on real
  responses: HSTS/`nosniff`/uniform CSP on `/`, `geolocation=(self)` vs
  `geolocation=()` on `/map/` vs `/`, the dedicated SVG policy on
  `/figures/f.svg` and `/r/<pub>/fig.svg` (Docker-gated).

## Honesty notes

- The meta tag is a real enforcement layer (everything except
  `frame-ancestors`/`sandbox`/`report-*` — exactly what the header
  carries); served-header claims name the template layer, and hosted
  verification stays `prepared_not_executed` per
  `live_verification=false`.
- Local Node is v25.2.1 vs the `>=24 <25` engines pin — the package
  gates ran green here; CI's pinned toolchain is authoritative.
- Composed nginx legs are Docker-gated — recorded as skipped (never
  claimed green) when no daemon is present.
- Full verification + the fix arc land in
  `docs/build/runs/P36.19.md`.
